assumptions: Snapshot positions, collateral, funding indices and margin rates are frozen.
Shared unlocked plus locked collateral is counted once; accrued funding is subtracted once through SDK equity contribution.
PnL truncates toward zero; funding rounds toward positive infinity; margin requirements round up, matching SDK 0.32.1.
Shocked prices round down to raw quote units and are hypothetical marks, not executable limit prices.
Resting orders are not filled or cancelled in this scenario. Fees, slippage, future funding, deposits, withdrawals and liquidation actions are excluded.
Maintenance headroom is a frozen-model comparison, not an exact liquidation price or protection guarantee.
